SHOP_ID_REQUIRED: shopId is required when creating an order as WAREHOUSE_ADMIN
PRODUCT_NOT_IN_WAREHOUSE: Product {productId} does not exist in warehouse inventory
OUT_OF_STOCK: Product "{product}" is out of stock and cannot be ordered
CANNOT_CANCEL: Cannot cancel an order with status {status}. Only PENDING and PROCESSING orders can be cancelled
CANCEL_OWN_ONLY: You can only cancel orders assigned to your shop
CANCEL_PENDING_ONLY: Shop owners can only cancel PENDING orders
UPDATE_OWN_ONLY: You can only update status for orders assigned to your shop
SHIPPED_TO_RECEIVED_ONLY: Shop owners can only mark a SHIPPED order as RECEIVED
CONCURRENT_UPDATE: Order status was modified by another request. Please retry.
ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to this order
SELF_ORDER: A shop cannot place an order to itself
EMPTY_ITEMS: An order must contain at least one item
